text.Esta build foi otimizada para jogar na h: This build is optimized for landscape play.
text.Preparando recursos, validando assets e: Preparing resources, validating assets and anti-break systems.
text.Internacionalização completa em portuguê: Complete localization in Portuguese, English and Spanish.
text.Cada período funciona como um pacote ind: Each period works as an independent pack with its own nations, resources, units, technologies and saves.
text.O único período liberado nesta versão. A: The only period enabled in this version. Expansions remain isolated to protect the medieval campaign.
The Medieval Era is ready to begin.
text.Defina sua identidade antes de assumir o: Define your identity before taking command of the kingdom.
It will represent your ruler in the campaign.
text.Cada reino começa com um bônus diferente: Each kingdom starts with a different bonus.
text.Conduza sua civilização da fundação do p: Lead your civilization from the first settlement to the rule of a kingdom.
text.Estabeleça o primeiro assentamento e pre: Establish the first settlement and prepare the kingdom to survive frontier threats.
text.Experiência equilibrada para conhecer to: Balanced experience to learn all game systems.
text.Abra o painel de missão para ver os obje: Open the mission panel to view objectives.
text.Siga as instruções para aprender os sist: Follow the instructions to learn the kingdom systems.
text.A etapa será reconhecida automaticamente: The step will be recognized automatically.
text.Um erro foi capturado pelo sistema anti-: An error was captured by the anti-break system. You can try to recover the build without losing access.
text.Crônicas do Vale, seis civilizações, qua: Chronicles of the Vale, six civilizations, four ages and a full campaign.
text.Pólvora, navegação oceânica e grandes ro: Gunpowder, ocean navigation and major trade routes.
text.Fábricas, ferrovias, energia e produção: Factories, railways, energy and mass production.
text.Trincheiras, artilharia, primeiros veícu: Trenches, artillery, early vehicles and aviation.
text.Nações atuais, economia, diplomacia, log: Modern nations, economy, diplomacy, logistics and combined forces.
text.Foco em narrativa e aprendizado, com rec: Focus on story and learning, with extra resources and more spaced attacks.
text.Inimigo menos agressivo e economia do jo: Less aggressive enemy and a more forgiving player economy.
text.IA mais rápida, ondas maiores e decisões: Faster AI, larger waves and adaptive tactical decisions.
text.Desafio máximo: economia forte, pressão: Maximum challenge: strong economy, constant pressure and specialized counterattacks.
text.Estabeleça o primeiro assentamento, orga: Establish the first settlement, organize the economy and prepare a permanent defense.
text.Meu soberano, estas terras são férteis,: My sovereign, these lands are fertile, but they do not truly belong to anyone yet. The first settlement will decide the future of the Vale.
text.Precisamos reunir recursos, erguer casas: We must gather resources, build houses and complete a barracks before enemy scouts discover our position.
text.O assentamento começa a ganhar forma. Co: The settlement is taking shape. Complete the remaining structures and turn these fields into a kingdom.
text.O primeiro estandarte foi erguido. O Val: The first banner has been raised. The Vale now has a home and an army.
text.Resista à primeira ofensiva rival e prov: Withstand the first rival offensive and prove that your new kingdom can defend its borders.
text.Fumaça no horizonte! Tropas inimigas atr: Smoke on the horizon! Enemy troops cross the Northern Pass and march toward our settlement.
text.Forme uma força de defesa, sobreviva à p: Form a defensive force, survive the first wave and eliminate the invaders.
text.A linha ainda resiste. Não permita que a: The line still holds. Do not allow enemy pressure to break our formation.
text.A fronteira foi mantida. Os reinos vizin: The frontier has been held. Neighboring kingdoms now recognize the strength of your banner.
text.Transforme o povoado em uma sociedade fe: Transform the settlement into a feudal society by developing technology, population and advanced structures.
text.Uma nação não pode sobreviver apenas pel: A nation cannot survive by the sword alone. Knowledge and organization will determine who rules these plains.
text.Avance para a Era Feudal, pesquise tecno: Advance to the Feudal Age, research technologies and expand the kingdom population capacity.
text.As antigas ferramentas já não bastam. Co: The old tools are no longer enough. Keep investing in knowledge and infrastructure.
text.O antigo povoado tornou-se um reino feud: The former settlement has become a feudal kingdom, recognized for its economy and technological capability.
text.Enfrente ondas sucessivas, reúna um exér: Face successive waves, assemble a large army and break the siege imposed by the rival civilization.
text.As fogueiras inimigas cercam o horizonte: Enemy fires surround the horizon. They do not intend to raid and leave; they intend to destroy our kingdom.
text.Reúna oito guerreiros, suporte as ondas: Gather eight warriors, endure the waves and inflict enough losses to break the siege.
text.O inimigo vacila, mas ainda possui reser: The enemy wavers, but still has reserves. This battle will be decided by endurance.
text.O cerco foi rompido. As forças rivais ab: The siege has been broken. Rival forces abandon the walls and retreat to their lands.
text.Alcance a Era dos Reinos, domine a ident: Reach the Age of Kingdoms, master your civilization identity and win the decisive campaign for the Vale.
text.Todos os caminhos conduziram até este mo: Every path has led to this moment. The Vale needs a single crown and a nation capable of sustaining it.
text.Evolua o reino, conclua nossa tecnologia: Develop the kingdom, complete our national technology and survive the rival final waves.
text.A coroa está próxima, mas o inimigo empr: The crown is near, but the enemy will use everything it still has. Do not retreat.
text.O Vale foi unificado sob seu governo. Se: The Vale has been united under your rule. Your name will be remembered among the great rulers of history.
text.Priorize madeira e alimento. Construa as: Prioritize wood and food. Build both houses before the barracks to avoid blocking population.
text.Forme infantaria cedo, mantenha arqueiro: Train infantry early, keep archers behind the line and do not chase the enemy far from the base.
text.Garanta duas tecnologias econômicas ante: Secure two economic technologies before investing in a very large military expansion.
text.Use postos avançados para antecipar onda: Use outposts to anticipate waves and keep food and gold reserves for replacements.
text.Controle território, conclua a tecnologi: Control territory, complete the national technology and attack only when your economy can sustain losses.
text.Este treinamento ensina os controles ess: This training teaches the essential controls without counting as a campaign chapter. You can skip any step.
text.Arraste o terreno para mover a câmera. N: Drag the terrain to move the camera. On desktop, you can also use WASD or the arrow keys.
text.Mova a câmera até a etapa ser reconhecid: Move the camera until the step is recognized.
text.Toque em um aldeão no mapa ou use o botã: Tap a villager on the map or use the villager selection button.
text.Unidades selecionadas recebem um círculo: Selected units receive a golden circle.
text.Com aldeões selecionados, toque no ícone: With villagers selected, tap the wood icon. They will gather, carry and deposit automatically.
text.A etapa conclui após a primeira entrega: The step completes after the first delivery to the Town Center.
text.Abra o menu de construção e coloque duas: Open the build menu and place two houses on free terrain. Houses increase the population cap.
text.Selecione aldeões, toque no martelo e de: Select villagers, tap the hammer and then the house icon.
text.O moinho fortalece a economia de aliment: The mill strengthens the food economy and is required to advance ages.
text.Abra novamente o menu de construção e es: Open the build menu again and choose the mill.
text.Use o Centro Urbano para criar trabalhad: Use the Town Center to create workers. A balanced economy needs an active population.
text.Toque no ícone de aumentar população e a: Tap the increase population icon and wait for production.
text.O quartel libera treinamento de infantar: The barracks unlocks infantry training and completes the base required for the Feudal Age.
text.Selecione aldeões, abra construção e pos: Select villagers, open construction and place the barracks.
text.Toque no quartel da HUD e depois no ícon: Tap the barracks on the HUD and then the infantry icon.
Technologies grant permanent bonuses. Start with Stone Tools in the economic branch.
text.Abra TECNOLOGIAS no topo e inicie uma pe: Open TECHNOLOGIES at the top and start an available research.
text.Abra o painel de Era, confirme os requis: Open the Age panel, confirm the requirements and begin the kingdom evolution.
text.A pesquisa pode levar alguns segundos; a: Research may take a few seconds; follow the progress on the HUD.
text.Selecione tropas, ative o comando de ata: Select troops, activate the attack command and tap a revealed enemy.
text.Formações e arqueiros ajudam a reduzir b: Formations and archers help reduce casualties.
text.Mantenha unidades próximas de um marcado: Keep units near a territorial marker until capture reaches 100%.
text.Use o botão Salvar. O jogo também possui: Use the Save button. The game also has autosave and automatic backup.
text.O save manual confirma que você domina o: The manual save confirms that you master the basic game loop.
text.Reorganize suas forças, consulte as dica: Reorganize your forces, review the tips and try again.
text.Você aprendeu câmera, economia, construç: You learned camera, economy, construction, population, army, technology, ages, combat, territory and saving.
text.Volte ao mapa da campanha para iniciar o: Return to the campaign map to start Chapter I with clean progress.
text.Iluminação, partículas e feedback visual: Full lighting, particles and visual feedback.
text.Backup restaurado. Use Continuar para ca: Backup restored. Use Continue to load it.
text.Backup inválido e não restaurado: Invalid backup; it was not restored
text.Não existe partida para exportar: There is no game to export
text.Save importado. Use Continuar para carre: Save imported. Use Continue to load it.
text.Modo ataque: toque em uma unidade inimig: Attack mode: tap an enemy unit
text.Modo reparo: toque em um edifício danifi: Repair mode: tap a damaged building
text.Novo mapa procedural, nova IA e nova fro: New procedural map, new AI and new frontier created
Profile ready to start the campaign.

text.Selecione unidades militares para aplica: Select military units to apply a tactic
text.Arraste para mover a câmera, use pinça p: Drag to move the camera, pinch to zoom and tap contextual icons.
text.PWA preparada para GitHub Pages e uso of: PWA prepared for GitHub Pages and offline use after the first load.
Choose the ideal level for your device.
text.Trilha dinâmica e efeitos originais inte: Dynamic soundtrack and original effects integrated into this build.
text.Autosave a cada 60 segundos, ao ocultar: Autosave every 60 seconds, when hiding the page and when leaving the game.
text.Gera um relatório JSON com versão, ambie: Generates a JSON report with version, environment, DOM integrity, critical assets, storage and captured errors.
text.Altere o idioma sem reiniciar e sem modi: Change language without restarting or modifying campaign progress.
text.Português, inglês e espanhol com troca s: Portuguese, English and Spanish with safe language switching, campaign and saves preserved.
text.Preencha o nome e selecione avatar e naç: Enter a name and select an avatar and nation.
text.Pólvora, navegação oceânica e comércio i: Gunpowder, ocean navigation and international trade.
text.Cavalaria pesada de choque com grande re: Heavy shock cavalry with great endurance.
text.Cavalaria recebe vida, ataque e produção: Cavalry gains improved health, attack and production.
text.Mobilidade, pressão contínua e exército: Mobility, constant pressure and a fast army
text.Economia rica, pesquisa rápida e tropas: Rich economy, fast research and disciplined troops
text.Infantaria ganha ataque, velocidade e re: Infantry gains attack, speed and resilience.
text.Abra o treinamento militar e produza sua: Open military training and produce your first combat unit.
text.Aumenta vida e ataque de todo o exército: Increases health and attack of the entire army.
text.Concede armadura e resistência às unidad: Grants armor and resilience to units.
text.Seu exército e seus trabalhadores foram: Your army and workers were eliminated.
text.Release Candidate Final: conquistas, doc: Final Release Candidate: achievements, commercial documents, store kit and launch audit.
text.Campanha medieval, seis civilizações, tr: Medieval campaign, configurable skirmish, six civilizations, three languages, PWA, accessibility, audio, achievements and multi-era architecture.
text.Documentos comerciais em formato de prep: Commercial documents are preparation drafts. Legal review is recommended before public sale.
text.Escolha mapa, recursos, era inicial, dif: Choose map, resources, starting age, difficulty, and victory condition without changing campaign progress.
text.20 abates e eliminar a força rival: 20 kills and eliminate the rival force
text.Era Imperial, 18 tropas e economia forte: Imperial Age, 18 troops, and a strong economy
text.A partida livre usa save próprio e não a: Skirmish uses its own save and does not change campaign chapters, stars, or rewards.
text.Partida Livre: mapas personalizados, trê: Skirmish: custom maps, three victory conditions, and a save independent from the campaign.
text.Diplomacia, comércio, alianças, tréguas: Diplomacy, trade, alliances, truces and relations between civilizations.
text.O Porto Real deve ser construído junto à: The Royal Harbor must be built beside water
text.Portos, comércio marítimo e expansão nav: Ports, maritime trade and naval expansion.
text.Porto rival conquistado! Reforços navais: Rival port captured! Enemy naval reinforcements stopped.
